resolution: Built the host-driven Slider primitive — handoff item 1, the L1 law (RULED req_0604) closed with real framework work. The engine owns the thumb while the button is down (the V23/movePlacement precedent applied to scrubbing): framework/engine.zig grabs via a scroll-aware hitTestSlider next to the scrollbar grab, motion writes the pool node's slider_value and repaints with zero JS in the loop, the value streams to JS throttled ~60Hz change-deduped via __dispatchSliderChange, and __dispatchSliderCommit fires once on release as the authoritative settle. paintSlider draws track/fill/knob host-side (track = style background, fill = color). v8_app.zig ignores mid-drag sliderValue prop echoes (slider_dragging gate) so controlled values never fight the engine thumb. runtime grew <Slider value min max step onChange onCommit>; cart/hmsc-int/shell/fields.tsx WorkbenchSlider now renders THROUGH it, so NumField, SliderField, the shader lab, and the cutout tool rail all upgraded in the one place — commit-on-release (WBCHAR-0606) and nonlinear toTrack/fromTrack semantics kept.
